mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.5% (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals economic weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 12-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated corporate revenue forecasts.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the interaction signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in < 40% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are above 12-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year signals aggressive interest rate policy, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 105 indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are positive in < 40% of INDPRO > 105 instances.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index below 230 (CPIAUCSL < 230) signals low inflation, which is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to sustained central bank accommodative policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 230, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: GDP (GDPC1) exceeding 16500 billion dollars indicates a strong economic base, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained corporate profitability.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) in GDPC1 > 16500 periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 100k) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) signal a tight labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days via elevated consumer spending and corporate margins.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the labor market interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in < 40% of instances where PAYEMS > 100k and UNRATE < 4.0%.
